title: Views and Sites!
text: We visited the Sagrada Familia and Montserrat guided by Matt, a studied guide.  Prior to visiting the Sagrada Familia, we walked "Old Barcelona" visiting Roman ruins, historic Spanish churches down alley-like streets, spacious neighborhood squares plus the 1992 Barcelona Olympic grounds  and related venues.                                                                                            The Sagrada Familia was an unbelievable site; the immenseness of the Cathedral was breathtaking as were the towering spires. title: One of my best experiences
text:
Alberto Garcia was our driver and guide. He was amazing. So courteous and thoughtful. Showed us sights on route. Set up everything. Timed it perfectly. Treated us like family!
We highly recommend. 
We had 2 children with us too. 
Took us to a restaurant we never would have found.
author: jennied468

title: Highly recommended
text: Highly recommended service...very nice and professional driver with clean car and specially now in times of covid19 great job providing all you need to feel save.
author: Andrelange

title: FABULOUS DAY
text:
We were a group of 5 friends, picked up by Micheal at the cruise port and he took us to Monsterrat and winery. He was just great, soon got some Aussie humor going, took us to a great lunch spot, and he made sure we got into the line at the monestary to see the Basicalla, we had to be there by 10.30 before they shut the door.  He made sure we did it. 
Was just the best day, and he dropped us off at our accomadation at the end of the day.
thanks Micheal and of course Welcome pickups.  this is a great trip for day trips off a cruise boat as well. and very fairly priced.
author: Christine A

title: Montserrat & Segura Viudas Cava private transfer and tour
text: What an amazing experience! Our driver Josep was exceptional, we enjoyed lunch  at a family family run restaurant. The highlight of our trip was visiting the winery “Segura Viudas” a private tour of the underground Cellar and cava tasting along with some jamón and queso. Exceptional!!! 100% recommend
author: montse0072
